actions.action: Pin browsing membership to a committed version.
actions.mechanism: Traverse IDs alive at session watermark S, exactly once; later inserts are excluded, later deletions return ID-only markers.
actions.implementation: Add commit-ordered creation/deletion versions and retain tombstones. Sign cursors containing S, last ID, and ten-minute expiry. Query membership creation≤S<deletion, ordered by immutable ID.
actions.check: Under concurrent mutations, require collected IDs to equal the independently captured S-membership, with every count exactly one. Benchmark worst-case pages against 300 ms.
actions.risk: Requires atomic watermark publication; record contents are not historical snapshots.

actions.mechanism: Freeze ordered membership into indexed ordinal slots, avoiding repeated visibility filtering during page reads.
actions.implementation: Build manifests in bounded background chunks using watermark membership; publish only when complete. Store in the existing store; cap concurrent builds and expire within ten minutes.
actions.check: During builds and reads, insert/delete records; compare returned IDs and multiplicities against watermark membership. Load-test pending responses and pages below 300 ms.
actions.risk: Adds readiness delay and storage. Return deletion markers; use deadline errors without advancing cursors.
